final: WITH per_operator AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE scancount IS NOT NULL OR (gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0) GROUP BY crewref), all_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM per_operator) SELECT AVG(total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_average FROM per_operator CROSS JOIN all_average WHERE avg_gb_per_min > overall_avg
